name: rzem-ai-inference
description: Desktop AI image generation app — Electrobun + Vue 3 + Python sidecar

scripts.start: cd src/mainview && npm run build && cd ../.. && electrobun dev

scripts.build:canary: cd src/mainview && npm run build && cd ../.. && electrobun build --env=canary
